The '''Skysitter Restaurant''' was one of the most exclusive restaurants found in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Skysitter was located in the [[Ambassadorial Sector]] of the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], near the [[Nicandra Counterrevolutionary Signalmen's Memorial Building/Legends|Nicandra Counterrevolutionary Signalmen's Memorial Building]].

The restaurant sat atop a 1,000 meter spire rising high above the cityscape, offering patrons an expansive view of Galactic City. The entire structure was built to rotate on its spire, allowing for a complete, panoramic vista. Only the wealthiest [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] could afford to eat in the opulent Skysitter establishment.

The design of [[Indigo Tower]], another restaurant in the Senate District, was based on the Skysitter.
